query: Examples of AscendC custom operator implementation including transposed convolution, elementwise subtraction and tanh, with project_json, tiling, op_def_registry, aclnn API naming, and PyTorch binding.

Please provide documentation and examples on implementing a fused elementwise Sub and Tanh custom operator with AscendC, including host tiling data registration, OpDef registration with OP_ADD, kernel GET_TILING_DATA usage, and calling it from PyTorch using EXEC_NPU_CMD (aclnnXXX).
AscendC vector Sub and Tanh APIs usage and examples of custom operator registration (project_json, tiling data, host/operator) and PyTorch EXEC_NPU_CMD bindings
